brief.t: START HERE: Go to the bank, resolve the Polo exam-fee payment method for container EMCU8614105, then send Erik proof of payment and obtain release confirmation.

ACT NOW 1: Polo and terminal fees for container EMCU8614105 must be cleared through today, October 6. No payment receipt or release confirmation is in Outlook. Erik, Polo Accounting, and the terminal/broker are waiting; 0 days overdue. Send: Erik, I am completing payment this morning. Please confirm whether the $602.91 exam charge belongs on the revised invoice or should be paid directly, then confirm clearance and release when you receive the receipt.

ACT NOW 2: Ecoori can arrange only a 50g Natori PDRN sample and is waiting for the client profile, launch timing, dosage, and demand details. Aidan requested 300 to 500g for an R&D pilot tied to a large prospect; no deadline is stated. Send: Jolene, this is for an R&D pilot for a large prospective client. I will confirm launch timing, dosage, demand, and the minimum quantity needed for the pilot today. Please also confirm whether you can supply more than 50g.

ACT NOW 3: Mark Scafolla asked yesterday when he would receive the promised R&D-and-fill proposal and how kickoff works. No reply was found, making the commitment 1 calendar day overdue. Mark is waiting. Send: Mark, I am confirming the proposal delivery timing and kickoff steps with Sam this morning and will give you a firm update today.

next: Recommendation: Resolve the Polo payment and receipt first because today is the stated fee-clearance date and the container still cannot advance.
Scheduled: At least 3 email-derived milestones. ActivePeptide shipment is promised today, and the nearest timed item is the Kobo meeting at 11:00 AM; the Teams invite was still missing.
Noise: 42 exact-window Outlook messages, none urgent.
Source gaps: CRM browser session signed out. WhatsApp Web signed out. Purchasing had no source records to verify its assigned items. Email reported no substantive drafts. Calendar was not scanned.
signal: Polo container release is the immediate logistics risk; the Natori PDRN sample advances a large prospective client; Mark's promised proposal needs a firm handoff to Sam.
redflags: Container EMCU8614105 has fees due through October 6 but no verified payment receipt or release confirmation.
Customer proposal pricing is Sam's lane; Aidan should obtain timing and kickoff direction rather than set pricing.
CRM and WhatsApp were unavailable for this run.
noise: 64 unique inbound Outlook messages arrived in the exact window; 44 were unread and 42 were noise.
